query:
SELECT DISTINCT object_id
                FROM (
                    SELECT
                        object_id,
                        synctoken,
                        ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY object_id ORDER BY synctoken DESC) as rn
                    FROM calendarobjectchangelog
                    WHERE (principal, cal_id) = (?, ?)
                    AND synctoken > ?
                )
                WHERE rn = 1
                ORDER BY synctoken ASC
